scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened on a weekly basis. The position can be filled prior to the removal date.
Experience with the structure and function of the VMTH Livestock Services
Clinical experience and competence in livestock medicine and surgery.
Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm, will also include emergency coverage during after-hours, weekend and holidays

items.item_text: Current CA veterinary license, and in good standing with the CA Veterinary Medical Board.
Board certification or residency-trained in large animal internal medicine, with a livestock emphasis.
Clinical experience and competence in livestock medicine and surgery.
Experience with the structure and function of the VMTH Livestock Services
Experience in teaching (particularly clinical instruction), providing oversight of professional students, residents and technicians in all aspects of livestock medicine and surgery.
Experience with UC/VMTH data systems such as, but not limited to, VMACS, AGFA, and VIPER.

Serve as a Staff Veterinarian to provide consistent and quality veterinary care for food animals through the Livestock Medicine and Surgery Service of the William R. Pritchard Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital (VMTH). Provide care for cattle, sheep, goats and pigs. Provide clinical teaching for veterinary students and residents through the clinics and involvement in lecture and laboratory teaching exercises and other educational activities associated with the professional DVM curriculum, or outreach to producers and veterinarians.
Interpersonal, oral and written communication skills. Skills to work with others in a collegial team atmosphere.
